msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia la-flamenca-12-palmas-20.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a coral pink flamenca dress with white polka dots and layered ruffles, with a red flower in the hair from the reference, walking at a sunny white street in the old town of Martos, Jaén, Spain, with flower pots and olive hills behind, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia la-flamenca-12-palmas-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a fuchsia flamenca dress with white polka dots and big ruffled sleeves, with a dark embroidered shawl from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia la-flamenca-12-palmas-14.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a royal blue fitted flamenca dress with a long ruffled skirt and a fuchsia fringed shawl, on a dress form from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia la-flamenca-12-palmas-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of pink leather flamenco dance shoes with a strap and a small heel (flat lay) from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia la-flamenca-12-palmas-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing two classical Spanish guitars, one orange and one natural wood, on stands (still life) from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
